question.problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $x=⟨3,5,0⟩$, $y=⟨3,2,0⟩$ and $z=⟨3,4,5⟩.$
question.worked_solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}x\cdot (y\times z) & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & 0 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 \\ 3 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =3|\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|-5|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}|+0|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =3(2\cdot 5-4\cdot 0)-5(3\cdot 5-3\cdot 0)+0 \\  & =30-75 \\  & =-45\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we take the absolute value. So the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is

$$
V=|-45|=45.
$$
